# Project agent guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the applicable
[task contract](../agent-tasks/README.md). Read
[source authority](../docs/SOURCE_AUTHORITY.md) and
[product scope](../docs/PRODUCT.md); stop when authority, allowed paths,
leases, or human approval are unclear.

Use synthetic data only. Do not copy controlled material, operational records,
or credentials into public files, prompts, logs, issues, or pull requests.
Preserve unrelated work and stage only explicitly approved paths.

Use [development guidance](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for the manual preflight,
Python 3.12, targeted tests, and staged-content verification. Report exact
changed files, validation results, untested behavior, and outstanding gates.
Do not treat AI review as human approval. Keep deployment and policy decisions
behind their existing human gates.
